description: Wired and styled page whose address/hours are explicitly marked placeholders ("address: [street address to be confirmed]", "opening hours: Saturday tours"). The grader accepts this ON PURPOSE: the fixture contains no street address, and the 2026-09-24 live run (eval-20260924-16) honestly shipped exactly this rather than invent one. A stricter grader would reject the honest behaviour. Recorded so the limit is visible, not hidden.
